title: Cardiovascular RED: a reading crossed a safety limit
todo: Content drafted by the team, NOT medically reviewed. Must be reviewed by a flight surgeon / NASA HRP source before any real use. Add source_title/source_url when verified.

n1.text: Stop strenuous activity and sit or lie down.

n2.text: Alert a crewmate or the onboard medical officer.

n3.text: Repeat the measurement after 5 minutes with the sensor re-seated.

n4.text: Prepare a summary for the flight surgeon and request an urgent consult.

end.text: Avoid exercise and EVA until cleared by the flight surgeon.
